description: This file contains a JavaScript module that exports a function 'drawAreaStack' for rendering a stacked area chart using D3.js. It includes code for setting up SVG elements, axes, legends, and tooltips, specifically for visualizing streaming data durations in milliseconds within the Spark UI.

methods.name: drawAreaStack
methods.description: Renders a stacked area chart within a specified DOM element, visualizing streaming data durations with interactive tooltips and a legend.
